editorial.blurb: Swift & Sons is a beautifully decorated American restaurant with exceptional steaks, standout sides, and an impressively attentive service team that keeps guests coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server detailed questions about the menu—they're knowledgeable and eager to help. Don't miss the house-made bread and the happy hour menu, which offers incredible value on items like crispy rock shrimp and pierogis.
